model.name: RbDetailDrawer.closeAndMinimize impl
model.description: DESIGN-AHEAD (R27.8 drawer regression fix). MEASURED ROOT CAUSE in rb-detail-drawer.ts: (1) X doesnt close = .drawer-close click wired to minimize() at :173 (R25.4/BUG3 designed X=minimize-peek, ESC=close — Tron reverses: X must close). (2) not-minimized-on-open = attributeChangedCallback :84 sets open but NOT minimized -> opens expanded/empty. (3) grab-bar regressed = open-expanded + X=minimize makes the peek/restore states read backwards. FIX: (a) :173 .drawer-close -> this.close() not minimize(); (b) :84 also setAttribute(minimized) on first open (open-minimized peek); (c) grab-bar :172 already toggles minimized->expand = the restore, works once open-minimized is default. Preserve R22.2 pan/zoom + the R25.4 minimize()/expand() (reused, not removed). ESC->close (:303) unchanged.
